description: Labeled synthetic honeypot calls for WATSON. Ground-truth campaign ids are independent of the camp-NNNN ids the pipeline assigns. Each call carries IntelligenceFinding rows. callback_number is a literal E.164, the only kind Sherlock emits today. organization_name, url, payment_method, other, pretext, and person_name are included so the scorer is ready when ATLAS expands FindingKind emission. CLI/ANI, timing, and duration stay on the call record.
